_note: The right stick's strike (docs/design/right-hand-attacks-rulings.md section 2, Game Design's first values): worth in units, ki in all, stun in live ticks, carryBh and reachBh in body heights. quickRecover and chargeRecover make the commitment. windTicks: the quick strike's wind-up, which with quickRecover is its commitment (14). The dwell and the ladder are data/input/timing.json's strike block.

armour._note: Past the quick flick a hold has B's armour, a beam's on the stick too (docs/design/power-scale.md section 2). From fromTicks (0.2 s), a beam's hold from beamFromTicks (its first tick: playable-build.md section 2), a light never stops it, and does heavy.armour.lightMul of its damage. A medium stops it before mediumUntilTicks (stage 2, 28 ticks). A heavy, a beam or a grab stops it. A dodge makes a charged strike miss, and he's open for missOpenTicks (0.33 s).

steal._note: The stick steals his run, for QA's arm (docs/design/stick-lands.md): a quick flick from no stance that lands clean takes his run to 0, yours rises by what was taken, at most max, and he reels reelBase + reelPer each point. The AI never steals.

strikeStages._note: The plain hold's stages (docs/director/beams-own-move-plan.md step 2; playable-build.md section 2; beam-answers-2.md section 1). A right-stick strike's hold climbs the beam's ladder: its count is 2 + round(4 x level), taken at the request; stage s comes at stageTicks[s-1] live ticks from the request, no higher than its level's price (levels, over the quick's) affords. It never goes by itself (autoGoTicks is ignored with this on), and at the top it costs topDrainPerSec, stepping down when it can't pay. Its blow lands at the stage up to levelCap: damage and stun stop growing at stage 3, and the stages past it are for the swat and the punch.

lungeLight._note: The stick's quick strike at range (docs/ep/proposals/controller-vision.md section 5: a flick lands in about 11 ticks up close and about 25 at range, by the heavy lunge). On: from the middle band, out of any exchange, it asks for the light lunge and lands as a light on arrival: the light's time and worth, with the stick's direction, its stun and its carry. Up close and in a brawl it is the stick's own blow as before.

fullSend._note: Game Design, slam-and-pace.md section 1: a stick strike held to his top stage sends when it lands, in the family of its direction, at share of a full B: down on a foe in the air the slam (more than airBh body heights over the ground), down on the ground the down send from where he stands (World's embed), up skyward, toward across, away across (behind him once the turning send exists). A quick flick or a hold short of the top never sends. bendDeg is the planner's own bend (not read here yet). Off: as before.

flickKeep._note: Game Design's rulings (docs/design/gauntlet-plan.md section 5, rulings 1 to 3): a flick that can't start now is held, the newest only, quietly, and becomes his first blow out, its direction read then. Stunned, reeling or in a planned exchange with no window of his open: up to pendFollow.maxTicks. Launched, down or dropped: at most recoverTicks old when he's free (the face queue's 20), or refused recovering. A set piece: refused at once, set_piece. One his rival's planned exchange took is held the same way, never told answered. Off: bufferTicks, and answered.

pendFollow._note: A stick strike waiting for its blow follows its request: queued, it waits up to maxTicks; answered by a planned exchange or refused, it's told at once (stick_refused answered or refused). A hold the answer swept up becomes the charge on his first free tick, counting from then, nothing banked (Game Design, 2026-11-02). Off, it lapses after pendTicks as late, whatever happened.

flickRun._note: A landed quick flick counts in its striker's run, points of it, with the steal on top (Game Design, stick-lands.md, 2026-11-02): a light's 1 first, and a medium's 3 if stick-only still lost every trade break. At 1 it lost all 48 of 48 to the easy AI; at 3 it won 45 of 45. 1.5: Game Design's lever 1 for stick-only and Orb's scheme (gauntlet-plan.md sections 3 and 5, 2026-11-07).
